content: Root cause: The bug was caused by the PTP (Precision Time Protocol) cyclecounter and timecounter being initialized only during the first probing of the device and not being re-initialized after device recovery. This led to PTP becoming non-functional after a recovery event, as the necessary initialization steps were skipped. The patch fixes this by ensuring that PTP initialization occurs unconditionally on probing, allowing it to function correctly even after recovery.
